description: Vendor STEP as shipped: 'Bedrock V3000 Basic 3D model.step'. NOTE - the file superimposes THREE chassis variants at a single origin plus one shared set of connector solids. Nothing here is fabricated by us; this directory exists so brackets can be designed against exact vendor geometry.

variants.description: Three chassis solids at one origin. Distinguish them by their X half-width; every other dimension is shared.

chassis_60w.cooling: 13 fins per side tapering to 7 at full height, 10.15 mm Y pitch, tips 0.395 mm wide over Z 7..153

chassis_30w.cooling: 11 fins per side tapering to 5 at full height, tips 0.200 mm wide over Z 4..156

chassis_tile.cooling: fanless, no fins - 20410.1 mm2 clean flat on each of X = +/-14.5
chassis_tile.side_fixings: 6x M4x0.7, tapped from both ends, 3.5 mm max penetration per side

notes: Source: C:/Users/KyleKassen/Documents/Projects/ADRS/CAD/Solidrun/Bedrock V3000 Basic 3D model.step (copied here as shipped, 2026-09-01).
22 solids: 3 chassis variants + 19 shared connector/antenna solids. Import the whole file and you get all three chassis nested inside one another.
Every number above was re-measured from this file with lib/analyze_step.py and point/ring probes; nothing is transcribed from a datasheet.
Fin channels run along Z and are open at BOTH ends - the unit is convection-cooled as a vertical chimney with +Z up.
Fin banks are on BOTH +X and -X and are mirror-identical (407.30 mm2 of tip flats each on the 60W). There is no finned-one-side / bare-other-side variant.
Set BEDROCK_V3000_STEP to point at a copy elsewhere if you do not want the 44 MB file in your checkout.
